CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT_SEC
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
AS(
    SELECT
     BST.ACCTCODE AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BST.DATE_OPEN AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BST.DATE_UPDATED AS PeriodEndDate
    ,BST.CURRCODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BSTD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BST.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BST.BNK_CODE

    FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS_DELTA BSTD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BST ON BST.ACCTCODE = BSTD.ACCTCODE AND BST.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,IsoCurrencyCode
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,IsoCurrencyCode
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC SRC
    FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM

UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),SRC.PeriodStartDate, 101)
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL;

--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,UsageCategoryId
,CommitmentId
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
,SRC.PeriodEndDate AS PeriodEndDate
,'Securities' AS ProductId
,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS UsageCategoryId
,NULL AS CommitmentId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,UsageCategoryId
,CommitmentId
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate AS PeriodEndDate
,'Securities' AS ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS UsageCategoryId
,NULL AS CommitmentId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA;

END
